description: The file defines a utility module for making HTTP GET requests to an API, including helper functions for URL manipulation, authorization header construction, and integrating tenant or organization identifiers. It exposes a central function 'apiGet' that manages request details such as URL building, headers, and error handling.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is absolute based on whether it starts with 'http://' or 'https://'.

methods.name: joinUrl
methods.description: Concatenates a base URL and a path into a well-formed URL string, handling slashes appropriately.

methods.name: apiGet
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified URL, automatically injecting authorization headers and appending 'organization_id' as a query parameter if necessary. Handles response parsing and errors.
